verdict.rationale: Headless server runtime is a fair question for a 3D engine compared in a game-engine arena, so the axis applies. The evidence is all browser and renderer-centric (WebGLRenderer/WebGPURenderer setup, import maps, browser devtools). Nothing documents running scene or game logic headless in Node or a dedicated-server build without rendering. The npm package's existence alone does not show server-side, render-free operation.
